$comment: The retrieval recall gate's golden set (tm 255.8 · FR-MOD-06.3.2 · PLAN §D183). Every answerable question names the one passage that answers it; every seed passage is the seed's own chunk text, verbatim (prisma/seed.ts — a test holds that). The other sources are the rest of a small help centre, written to compete: they share words with the seed passages without answering the questions. The unanswerable questions have no answer anywhere in their agent's knowledge base, and are what RETRIEVAL_THRESHOLD is for. Loaded, validated and scored by test/helpers/knowledge-recall.ts; asked by test/integration/knowledge-recall-gate.test.ts (the fake provider, in CI) and by `pnpm --filter @nexa/api measure:knowledge-recall` (a real provider, by hand).

agents.ai_agent: The customer-facing AI agent — the seed's Ada.
agents.copilot: The agent-only copilot — the seed's Copilot, answering agents' questions.

sources.name: Delivery and returns
passages: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 working days across the EU.
Returns are accepted within 30 days if the item is unused and in its original packaging.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 working days of receipt.

sources.name: Agent playbook
passages: A refund over five hundred dollars must be approved by a manager before it is promised.
Escalate an angry or threatening customer to the duty lead rather than handling it alone.
Always confirm the order number before giving a delivery date.

sources.name: Order tracking
passages: Every order gets a tracking link by email as soon as it leaves the warehouse.
Orders placed before 2 pm on a working day are packed and dispatched the same day.

sources.name: International shipping
passages: We also ship to the United Kingdom, Norway and Switzerland, where customs duties are paid by the recipient.
Shipments outside the EU take 7 to 10 working days and cannot be sent to a PO box.

sources.name: Payment methods
passages: We accept Visa, Mastercard, PayPal and bank transfer at checkout.
Your card is charged when the order is dispatched, not when it is placed.

sources.name: Exchanges
passages: An item can be exchanged for another size or colour within 30 days of delivery.
The replacement is sent free of charge once the original item reaches our warehouse.

sources.name: Damaged or missing items
passages: If a parcel arrives damaged, photograph it and contact support within 48 hours.
A missing item is resent at no cost once the courier confirms the loss.

sources.name: Click and collect
passages: Click and collect orders wait at the store desk for seven days before they are sent back.

sources.name: Gift cards
passages: Gift cards never expire and cannot be exchanged for cash.
A lost gift card is replaced if you still have the purchase receipt.

sources.name: Account access
passages: Reset a forgotten password with the Forgot password link on the sign-in page; the link is valid for one hour.

sources.name: Cancelling an order
passages: An order can be cancelled free of charge until it has been packed; after that it has to be returned.

sources.name: Warranty
passages: Electronics carry a two-year warranty, and the order confirmation email counts as proof of purchase.

sources.name: Tone guide
passages: Greet the customer by name and keep every reply under five sentences.
Never promise a delivery date the courier has not confirmed.

sources.name: Shift handover
passages: Leave an internal note on every open chat before your shift ends.
A chat still waiting on a manager's approval is handed to the next shift's duty lead.

sources.name: Goodwill credit
passages: Agents may offer goodwill store credit of up to twenty dollars without asking anyone.
